context.canonical_title: Kafka 如何处理重复消费？
source_variants: Kafka 如何处理重复消费？

required_checks: Verify every material Kafka factual/config/API claim against primary Apache Kafka sources, including version/default boundaries.
Verify both source-question rows and all source variants are directly answered.

Check scenario completeness: assumptions, failure windows, state/transaction boundaries, idempotency, retry/degradation/compensation, observability, capacity, rollout/validation, alternatives and trade-offs.
Check that hypothetical examples are clearly examples and do not imply fabricated personal/project experience.
Check oral usability, question-specific follow-ups, and absence of legacy template contamination.
Produce an explicit pass/revise/reject decision, dimension scores, hard failures, unsupported claims, uncovered variants and findings.
review_contract.promotion_boundary: Do not promote or fabricate human approval. Pilot human review remains a separate mandatory gate when required by config.

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: Apache Kafka 4.1 Consumer Configs
claims_to_check: enable.auto.commit periodically commits offsets in the background and defaults to true
isolation.level=read_committed returns only committed transactional messages and withholds aborted/in-flight transactional data according to LSO semantics
max.poll.interval.ms bounds delay between poll invocations and can trigger group reassignment behavior
max.poll.records limits records returned from a single poll call

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: Apache Kafka 4.1 KafkaConsumer API
claims_to_check: current position and committed position are distinct recovery concepts
committed offset should be the next record to consume
commitAsync is non-blocking and errors are passed to callback when supplied or discarded when absent
KafkaConsumer is not thread-safe and decoupled consumption/processing requires explicit offset coordination

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: Apache Kafka 4.1 Producer Configs
claims_to_check: enable.idempotence defaults to true when there are no conflicting configs
idempotence requires acks=all, retries greater than 0 and max.in.flight.requests.per.connection less than or equal to 5

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: Apache Kafka 4.1 KafkaProducer API
claims_to_check: application-level re-sends are outside producer retry de-duplication and idempotence is session-bounded
sendOffsetsToTransaction marks offsets as part of the current transaction and they become committed only if the transaction commits
transactional.id enables transactional APIs and implies idempotence

primary_sources_to_verify_independently.title: Apache Kafka 4.1 Design
claims_to_check: Kafka exactly-once semantics are scoped to Kafka transactional processing boundaries and transaction-aware consumers

changes: tightened idempotence version wording to Kafka 4.1
